take_homes: The agent grades its own work softly because it was trained to be agreeable. Its self-review is a claim to check, not a result.
A cold second reader helps, but the order of your questions to it biases the answer.
Turn what worked into a rules file, then run a retro pass so the file improves. This is probably what I could hand to the non-engineers.
